location: sections/exact.tex:373-374 (proof of Thm 6.14 thm:exact, 'Bound under growth')
issue: The proof says 'REC, the evaluation of F(x~) and the comparison cost poly(I+q*)'. REC reads x^ (comparisons with l_i+tau and u_i-tau), and the bit length of x^ is not bounded by poly(I+q*).
evidence: By Appendix A (appendix-growth.tex:115-144), x^ is a grid node with denominator dividing Gamma_X 2^alpha, where alpha = J + O(I) + mu K_mu and mu K_mu <= 10 mu 2^mu (I+1). So x^ has O((1+mu 2^mu)(I+q+1)) bits, with 2^{mu*} <= 6 sqrt(kappa); q* contains only log kappa. The final bound f_1(p,kappa)(I+1)^{C_1} is unaffected, because the extra factor depends only on kappa and is absorbed into f_1.
fix: Replace the sentence with: "REC, the evaluation of $F(\tilde x)$ and the comparison cost a polynomial in $I+q^*$ and in the bit length of $\hat x$, which is $O((1+\mu2^\mu)(I+2q^*+1))$ with $2^\mu\le6\sqrt\kappa$ (Appendix~\ref{app:growth}); this factor is also absorbed into $f_1$."
